entities.name: Lord of Pain
entities.description: A human assassin from Duskmourn, the first razorkin and de facto leader of the razorkin, existing only in the House's screens.

entities.name: Razorkin
entities.description: Pain-seeking inhabitants of the House who loosely heed the Lord of Pain.

entities.name: The House
entities.description: The sentient house of Duskmourn with screens throughout.

entities.name: Razor mazes
entities.description: Mazes where hordes of razorkin lie in wait and the Lord of Pain's body is stashed.

entities.name: Cellarspawn
entities.description: Creature whose essence the Lord of Pain injected into himself.

events.summary: The Lord of Pain injects a cellarspawn's essence seeking unparalleled agony; instead his mind is flung into the House's screens.
events.quote: it wrenched his mind from his body and flung it into the screens of the House

events.summary: Watching a survivor's death through a screen, he abandons his mortal body to live in the screens.
events.quote: he gleefully abandoned his mortal body to live exclusively within the House's screens

relations.quote: He is the de facto leader of the razorkin.
